news.title: NYSE picks Avalanche to settle tokenized stocks amid Wall Street's blockchain race
news.summary: Avalanche will serve as the core settlement ledger for the exchange's planned blockchain stock market

news.title: A Bitcoin block just neared a 2015 transaction record, but paid only $180 in fees
news.summary: The AntPool block came within 984 transactions of Bitcoin’s 2015 record, even as fees made up less than 0.1% of the miner’s payout.

news.title: Bitcoin faces U.S. CPI test as analysts warn inflation relief may not be enough
news.summary: Bitcoin trades below $75,000 ahead of the October inflation data. Analysts warning that sustainable recovery depends on improving liquidity and spot ETF demand rather than temporary macro relief.

news.title: Bitcoin miner MARA sold 13,597 BTC for $1.1 billion in six weeks, plans to sell more
news.summary: MARA paid off every loan backed by its bitcoin and says the rest of its coins can fund AI datacenters.

news.title: An 11-year-old Ethereum wallet moved $4.6 million and dodged a scam set up in minutes
news.summary: Bots spotted a wallet from Ethereum’s 2015 launch the moment it stirred and planted lookalike addresses in its history, but the owner sent the money to the right place anyway.

news.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
news.summary: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.
